changelog:
v2.1.0 — Flick V2 Complete UI & Valorant Calibration

- Flick V2 tab: Gain, Settle Delay, Max Counts, Budget, Iterations, Deadzone, Switch Radius for Main and Sec.
- Valorant calibration: 0.07 deg/count preset, cm/360 cross-check, measured fit with provenance (source, samples, R2).
- Performance: preview throttling, anti-smoke cache, UI scheduler gating, debug log incremental, geometry/calibration cache, per-tag move queue dispatch.
- Fixes: calibration impulse isolation, flick rollback timing, duplicate config load, stale debug widget, settle/budget validation.
- Cleanup: removed dead Magnet Trigger UI and unused UI builders; unified version across title, badge, README and changelog.
